Utilization rate = loan copies ÷ collection copies × 100%; turnover rate = loan copies ÷ collection copies. Computation is done locally in the browser, no data uploaded to the server.

map.流通率 = 年借阅册次 ÷ 馆藏总册数 × 100%；读者人均借阅 = 年借阅册: Circulation rate = annual loan copies ÷ total collection copies × 100%; per-capita reader loans = annual loan copies ÷ registered readers; visit rate = annual visits ÷ registered readers; new-acquisition ratio = annual new collection ÷ total collection copies × 100%; book turnover days = 365 ÷ circulation rate; year-over-year change rate of each metric = (this-year value − last-year value) ÷ last-year value × 100%, used for horizontal and vertical comparison of collection use efficiency.
map.档案或资产盘点时，输入台账明细自动汇总总件数、各类型数量与占比，生成分类统计报表: When taking inventory of archives or assets, enter ledger details to auto-summarize total items, quantities and ratios by type, generating a classification statistics report for verification.
map.计算利用率：利用率 = 利用件次 ÷ 总件数 × 100%，按月或按年输出，反映: Compute utilization: utilization rate = used item-times ÷ total items × 100%, output by month or year, reflecting collection activity and usage structure.
map.按维度（年度、类型、保管机构）交叉汇总，定位长期闲置或高频调阅的类别，辅助排架与: Cross-summarize by dimensions (year, type, custodian organization) to locate long-idle or high-frequency categories, assisting shelving and digitization priority decisions.
map.某全宗总件数 1200 件，全年利用登记 360 件次，则利用率=360÷120: A fonds with total 1200 items, 360 used-times registered in a year, utilization rate = 360÷1200×100% = 30%. Split by type: document category 800 items used 300 times (37.5%), business category 400 items used 60 times (15%), showing the document category is used more frequently.
map.常用口径：利用率 = 统计期内利用件次 ÷ 总件数 × 100%。注意分子是'件: Common approach: utilization rate = used item-times within the period ÷ total items × 100%. Note the numerator is 'item-times' (the same item counted repeatedly when used multiple times) and the denominator is 'item count'; they have different units and must be listed separately in the report to avoid misreading.
map.类型占比和利用率是一回事吗？: Are type ratio and utilization the same thing?
map.不是。类型占比 = 某类件数 ÷ 总件数，反映馆藏结构；利用率反映被调阅的频繁程: No. Type ratio = items of a type ÷ total items, reflecting collection structure; utilization reflects how frequently items are retrieved. Only combined can you judge 'which categories are many, which are used much'; looking at one alone leads to misjudgment.
